entities.name: UE Assistance Information procedure
entities.description: Procedure for the UE to inform the network about various preferences and assistance information including delay budget, overheating, IDC assistance, power saving preferences, and MUSIM operation preferences.

entities.name: RRCReconfiguration
entities.description: Message sent from network to UE to configure RRC parameters.

entities.name: UEAssistanceInformation
entities.description: Message sent from UE to network containing assistance information and preferences.

entities.name: Delay budget report
entities.description: Carries desired increment/decrement in the connected mode DRX cycle length.

entities.name: Power saving preferences
entities.description: UE preferences for DRX parameters, bandwidth, MIMO layers, and scheduling offset for power saving.

entities.name: MUSIM operation preferences
entities.description: UE preferences for MUSIM gaps and transition out of RRC_CONNECTED state.

entities.name: RRC_CONNECTED
entities.description: RRC connected state where UE can transmit and receive data.

relations.description: UE Assistance Information procedure involves sending UEAssistanceInformation message
UEAssistanceInformation message contains delay budget report IE
UEAssistanceInformation message contains overheating assistance IE
UEAssistanceInformation message contains IDC assistance IE
UEAssistanceInformation message contains power saving preferences IE
UEAssistanceInformation message contains MUSIM operation preferences IE
UE Assistance Information procedure requires UE to be in RRC_CONNECTED state
